## Clinic Overview
- **Clinic Name:** Medicare Skin & Cosmetic Clinic
- **Consultant Dermatologist:** Dr. (Mrs.) Sujay M, MBBS, DDVL
- **Qualifications:** MBBS, DDVL (Diploma in Dermatology, Venereology and Leprosy). Registered Medical Practitioner.
- **Location:** Jyothi Kendriya Vidyalaya Back Gate, 2nd Main, 2nd Cross, Jyothi Layout, Yelachenahalli, Kanakapura Main Road, South Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India.
- **Landmark:** 1-minute walk from Yelachenahalli Metro Station (Namma Metro Green Line, Exit Gate 2).
- **Telephone:** +91 92428 55707
- **Appointment Request:** https://www.medicareskin.com/book-appointment/
- **Clinical Policy:** Strictly evidence-based dermatology. In-person clinical assessment is required before any prescription or procedural intervention. No guaranteed permanent cure claims for chronic conditions such as melasma, vitiligo, or eczema.

## Authoritative 10 Treatment Landing Pages
1. **Pigmentation & Dark Spots:**
   - Focus: Melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), sun spots, Indian skin photoprotection.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/skin/pigmentation-treatment/

2. **Q-Switched Laser Consultation:**
   - Focus: Selected benign pigmented spots, laser toning limitations, melasma recurrence risks, hypopigmentation precautions.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/laser/q-switched-laser/

3. **Laser Hair Reduction:**
   - Focus: Face, underarms, legs, body; long-pulsed Nd:YAG and diode systems for Indian Fitzpatrick skin tones IV–VI.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/laser/laser-hair-reduction/

4. **Hair Loss & Thinning Assessment:**
   - Focus: Pattern hair loss, telogen effluvium, targeted ferritin/thyroid blood investigations, medical therapies.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/hair/hair-loss-treatment/

5. **HydraFacial & Hydrodermabrasion:**
   - Focus: Device-assisted cleansing, gentle exfoliation, extraction, hydration; event prep guidelines and skin barrier evaluation.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/aesthetics/hydrafacial/

6. **Chemical Peels:**
   - Focus: Calibrated superficial peeling (glycolic, salicylic, lactic, mandelic) for texture, acne marks, and tone; PIH prevention.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/skin/chemical-peels/

7. **PRP vs GFC Hair Treatment:**
   - Focus: Platelet-rich plasma vs growth factor concentrate; comparative evidence, realistic regrowth expectations.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/hair/prp-gfc/

8. **Eczema & Atopic Dermatitis:**
   - Focus: Chronic itchy rash management, barrier restoration, fragrance-free emollient regimens, safe topical steroid guidance.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/eczema/

9. **Psoriasis Care:**
   - Focus: Plaque, scalp, nail psoriasis on Indian skin; non-contagious nature, systemic monitoring, psoriatic arthritis flags.
   - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/psoriasis/

10. **Vitiligo & White Patches:**
    - Focus: Autoimmune melanocyte loss, fungal vs vitiligo differentiation, thyroid screening, medical/phototherapy options.
    - Canonical URL: https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/vitiligo/
